patch_description: This redesign replaces a single random point cloud with a deterministic multi-start spherical-code optimizer. Points are initialized from both a structured cube-octahedron seed and reproducible randomized sphere samples. A staged smooth min/max-distance objective is optimized with projected gradient updates directly on the unit sphere, while retaining the best true pairwise-distance ratio observed across all iterations and starts. The modular helpers separate initialization, scoring, smooth-gradient construction, and search orchestration.
